snippet.title: The Edutainment Vortex Diner - Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time to make learning fun, with sandwiches and smalltalk at the Edutainment Vortex Diner! Meet ageless and immortal teachers. Get good grades or embrace your inner bratty problem child! Be not afraid. Let's inherit a terrible burden together. The vortex beckons...

A visual novel from the makers of Arcade Spirits and Penny Larceny, this weird little bit of horror-comedy will make you laugh, think, probably get big mad about the world, and ponder the complexities of life while learning very little whatsoever. Doesn't that sound fun?

Find out more at: https://www.fictionfactorygames.com
Join our Discord at: https://discord.gg/gaCcH2N
